purpose: A short deep bilobed pit with paired scratch fields, retaining the original negative-impression display convention. Both lobes must read as excavated depth rather than a raised cast. Keep it distinct from a long Cruziana walking furrow and from a shallow Lockeia almond impression. Sediment and any section are illustrative; no named producer species or behavior certainty.
